title: Mochi Pudding
description: A Japanese-style dessert made with fluffy mochi and sweet pudding. This dessert is perfect for warm weather and is easy to make.

ingredients.name: Filipino Mochi
ingredients.notes: Available at Asian markets or online

instructions: Dust a surface with flour and knead the mochi until it becomes pliable.
Divide the mochi into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Pour the prepared pudding into a saucepan and heat it over low heat, stirring constantly.
Bring the pudding to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until it thickens.
Place a disk of mochi on a plate and top it with a scoop of warmed pudding.
Repeat with the remaining mochi and pudding.
